# Repository instructions for Copilot

This is a beginner-first repository.

## Expectations

- Keep changes small and easy to review.
- Prefer clear naming and simple structure over clever code.
- Add or update README documentation when behavior changes.
- Run project checks before finalizing changes.

## Workflow

1. Understand existing files before editing.
2. Propose a short plan for non-trivial changes.
3. Validate changes with available automation.
4. Keep pull requests focused on one task.
